prompt_fotobn: A small leather coin purse seen straight from the front, closed, standing upright on a grey surface, with a metal clasp across the top. The clasp is the green object.

A neat stack of three thin rectangular slabs, each offset slightly from the one below, on a grey surface. The top slab is the green object.

An empty black picture frame leaning against a grey wall, with a small paintbrush lying on the surface in front of it. The paintbrush is the green object.
